note: Series, formats and home-court patterns are rebuilt from game results (1996-97 to 2025-26). 'seed' is the published playoff seed where seedSource is 'published' (checked against the actual bracket), otherwise a reconstructed bracket position ('pos' is always the reconstruction). Seeds never decide home court. In every real series the team with the better regular-season record hosted; for hypothetical matchups with equal records the tiebreak is a labelled simulation assumption, not an official rule. 'history' is reference only and is never a model input.
